links.outcome: Agreement of generative AI with expert-curated DDI system on mechanism and severity
links.effect: Mechanism agreement over 99%; CKAI assigned higher severity than LexiDrug and often recommended 'avoid' over nuanced modifications; evidence categorization diverged.
links.quote: CKAI consistently assigned higher severity levels compared to LexiDrug and frequently recommended “avoid” actions rather than nuanced modifications.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a retrieval-augmented LLM (ClinicalKey AI) compared against an established human-curated expert system (LexiDrug) on 280 drug pairs for drug-drug interaction screening.
